props.title: PCSS II Robotics | Student Engineering in Saugus, MA
props.description: Explore robotics projects, STEM events, and game programming resources from Pioneer Charter School of Science II in Saugus, Massachusetts.

props.title: Build a robot.
props.description: PCSS II Robotics brings students together to design, code, test, and share what they make. Explore the team’s projects, try an interactive simulator, or join the next community jam.

props.title: There’s room to learn.
props.text: You can start with curiosity. Ask the school how to join the team and what opportunities are available this season.

props.title: Sponsor student robotics.
props.text: Help students build with materials, mentorship, or event support. The school can provide current tax documents and confirm the legal recipient.
